_comment: Test fixture, not a plan: a hand-written host_knobs/host_storage pair for the CBP2025 kit at 6074966, following predictorsize() in cbp2016_tage_sc_l.h term by term. Its terms reproduce the 524615 bits that function prints. The loop never reads this file; the planner derives its own.

host_knobs.name: logg
host_knobs.observed: #define LOGG 10         /* logsize of the  banks in the  tagged TAGE tables */
host_knobs.description: Entries per tagged bank, log2, for every bank (logg[i] = LOGG).

host_knobs.name: tbits
host_knobs.observed: #define TBITS 8         //minimum width of the tags  (low history lengths), +4 for high history lengths
host_knobs.description: Tag width of the low banks; the high banks use TBITS + 4.

host_knobs.name: nbanklow
host_knobs.observed: #define NBANKLOW 10     // number of banks in the shared bank-interleaved for the low history lengths
host_knobs.description: Tagged banks shared by the short histories.

host_knobs.name: nbankhigh
host_knobs.observed: #define NBANKHIGH 20        // number of banks in the shared bank-interleaved for the  history lengths
host_knobs.description: Tagged banks shared by the long histories.

host_knobs.name: cwidth
host_knobs.observed: #define CWIDTH 3        // predictor counter width on the TAGE tagged tables
host_knobs.description: Prediction counter width in the tagged tables.

host_knobs.name: logb
host_knobs.observed: #define LOGB 13         // log of number of entries in bimodal predictor
host_knobs.description: Bimodal entries, log2; hysteresis is shared by 2^HYSTSHIFT entries.

host_knobs.name: percwidth
host_knobs.description: Width of every statistical-corrector weight counter.

host_knobs.name: loggnb
host_knobs.description: Global-history GEHL tables, log2; two of the three are half size.

host_storage.measured_by: predictorsize() in cbp2016_tage_sc_l.h, built with PRINTSIZE on a scratch copy
